video.title: AI欧腐《爱上父亲的私生子/Crush On My Dad's Illegitimate Son》
video.desc:
After his father's death, the heir apparent is set to inherit the family fortune and title—until a man claiming to be his father's illegitimate son suddenly appears. Forced to share a home with this half-brother, the young heir finds himself drawn to him in ways that go far beyond brotherhood. But the more he falls, the more he realizes the man he's falling for is hiding a dangerous secret.
父亲去世后，身为法定继承人的年轻少爷本该继承家族财富与爵位。可就在这时，一个自称是他父亲私生子的男人突然出现，打乱了一切。
被迫与这位“同父异母的兄弟”住在同一屋檐下后，年轻继承人渐渐被他吸引，而这份感情早已超越了兄弟之情。
可他陷得越深，就越发现，自己爱上的这个男人，似乎隐藏着一个危险的秘密。
